articles.title_en: Russia hits Odesa with missiles and 130 drones overnight, killing two — its second deadly strike on the city in three days

articles.title_en: Rospotrebnadzor specialists help Venezuela after earthquake
articles.lead_en: In the coming days, they will visit mobile hospitals and temporary accommodation centers in the state of La Guaira, which was most affected by the earthquake, said Vasily Kuklev, leading researcher at the epidemiology department of the Russian anti-plague institute "Microbe".
